text:
elaine (people-ops): Hey team - dropping a tiny pack of 60s goal & feedback lines you can paste into OKRs, self-reviews, or 1:1s. TL;DR: 3 micro-templates (Committed, Stretch, Impact) + peer prompts + a one-sentence example. Pls react :eyes: and flag anything confusing. Office hours Thu 3pm if you want live walkthrough.

samir: Nice, thanks! Quick Q - should committed goals always have a hard metric or is outcome wording ok?

elaine (people-ops): Prefer a metric when it's clear, but outcome-focused is fine if metric is noisy. Examples below to cover both.

marta: Putting a few examples into manager comms would be helpful - especially for cross-team goals.

elaine (people-ops): Good call. Here are copy-paste lines you can use. Each is ~1 line (60s read).

--- examples ---
Committed - Reduce inference tail latency for hosted API p95 from 320ms to <=220ms by EOY (measured on prod region-us).
Committed - Ship streaming SDK v1 with documentation and 3 sample apps by end of Q2 (tracked via release checklist).
Committed - Increase monthly active prompt evaluations by 30% by improving quickstart flows and in-product prompts.

Stretch - Evaluate 2 new quantized model families and pilot on Dedicated to cut per-token cost by 20% while keeping quality within 5% of baseline.
Stretch - Lead cross-org reliability sprint to get incident MTTR down 40% for model deploys.

Impact headline - Launched streaming SDK + sample apps; enabled 3 partners to integrate, reducing integration time from weeks to days.
Impact headline (IC) - Reduced p95 latency 30%, which dropped per-request cost and improved conversion on realtime features.

Peer feedback prompts (paste for reviews) -
 What concrete outcome did they drive?
 Where did they unblock others and how?
 One area to focus on next quarter (short, specific).

One-line self-review starter (pasteable):
"I owned the streaming SDK launch (ship + docs + 3 samples), which cut partner integration time by ~60% and increased trial activation by 18%. Next quarter I want to focus on improving SDK telemetry to measure adoption flows."

--- end examples ---

jess: These are great. Could we add a tiny dos/don'ts note? Like 'Do: include a clear metric or timeline. Don't: write vague activity statements.'

elaine (people-ops): Yup - added to the doc: Do include measurable outcomes, tie goals to customer or platform impact, and prefer short, transferable phrasing. Don't write task lists or vague verbs ("help", "support").

samir: Awesome. Any guidance on how managers should convert team goals into 1:1 conversation bullets?

elaine (people-ops): Keep it to 3 bullets: 1) where we are vs committed, 2) one ask for the individual (skill/time), 3) next milestone. Example: "p95 at 260ms (on track), can you own the A/B telemetry for this sprint, next milestone: p95 <=240ms by 05/15."

marta: I'll paste these into my manager notes - thanks!

hr-bot: Reminder: Q2 self-review window opens 2025-05-01 and closes 2025-05-10. Drop any questions in this thread or join elaine's office hours.

elaine (people-ops): Thanks all. If you'd like, drop one real-world goal from your work and I'll help make it paste-ready in this thread. :thumbsup:
